input_selection: Use the first declared case, its complete basis and every generated include, without overrides. The runtime manifest binds the case table and model bytes by SHA-256.
resource_basis: One timed canary before extrapolating; no parallel native cases.

readback.endpoint_positions: m; global frame, including stinger exit and touchdown
readback.effective_tension: kN; arc-length array and matched upper free-span endpoint
readback.roller_reaction: kN; each station, contact state and force direction
readback.force_balance: kN; sum of endpoint, support and distributed forces

timing.start: Immediately before native model loading for this case, after preparation and queue wait.
timing.stop: After the saved native state is reopened and all required readback quantities are retained.
timing.existing_batch_duration: cases.csv wall_seconds is a worker duration only; it does not substitute for complete native readback timing.
timing.projection: No campaign projection until the timed case has native readback and a recorded resource configuration. A single case does not establish the duration of every case.

release: Remaining cases remain held pending canary readback, sourced numerical criteria and explicit digest-bound queue approval.
